Application Data.NAME: Concrete Solutions LLC
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Concrete Ave Suite 200, Construction City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Concrete Solutions LLC specializes in providing comprehensive concrete and masonry services, including residential and commercial projects such as foundations, driveways, patios, and structural elements. We prioritize sourcing materials from compliant suppliers to ensure adherence to local environmental regulations and industry standards. Our team is committed to safe work practices, utilizing proper equipment and training to minimize jobsite injuries. We also maintain thorough documentation of material testing to comply with ASTM C1567, avoiding the use of high-alkali cement mixtures. Our risk management strategies include proactive measures for pollution liability and regular inspections to prevent property damage and maintain high workmanship standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a minor site incident occurred during the pouring of a residential driveway due to a sudden rainstorm causing water accumulation on the surface before proper curing. The remediation cost was $3,500. The issue was resolved by re-pouring the affected section of the driveway, and it is currently marked as Closed. On July 10, 2023, we experienced a claim regarding property damage to a client's fence caused by equipment during excavation work. The total amount settled for this claim was $8,500. This claim is also marked as Closed. Total loss amount to date is $12,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around job sites, 24/7 on-site supervision during high-risk work, and regular site inspections.
